findings.title: ServiceAccount does not exist
findings.cause: Deployment kd-missing-serviceaccount/web cannot create pods: its pods run as ServiceAccount web-sa, which does not exist in namespace kd-missing-serviceaccount

evidence.detail: Error creating: pods "web-9f8686467-" is forbidden: error looking up service account kd-missing-serviceaccount/web-sa: serviceaccount "web-sa" not found

findings.fix: Create ServiceAccount web-sa in namespace kd-missing-serviceaccount, or set serviceAccountName to one that exists.
